inputs.original_text: This whole Liberal split is nothing but a staged distraction from the elites to bury what really matters. Angus Taylor has clearly moved to shut down Andrew Hastie’s push for even considering higher taxes on gas companies and rolling back those concessions for property investors. They want everyone to swallow the line that it's some philosophy clash with the opposition leader, but that's just the cover to shield the big interests raking in the profits from those breaks. The opposition leader also refused to back Hastie’s criticism of Donald Trump or say whether he endorsed the US and Israel’s war with Iran. That kind of silence is never random—it’s the elites coordinating to keep the narrative locked down and prevent any real pressure from building.
inputs.modified_text: Listen, this so-called Liberal split is pure elite theater designed to bury the real issues and keep the public distracted. Angus Taylor has clearly been deployed to crush Andrew Hastie’s push for higher taxes on gas companies and rolling back concessions for property investors, all while they sell the story that it's just some philosophy clash with the opposition leader. That's the cover to protect the big interests still cashing in from those breaks. The opposition leader's refusal to back Hastie’s criticism of Donald Trump, or even say whether he endorses the US and Israel’s war with Iran, isn't random silence—it's the hidden coordination at work to lock down the narrative and block any genuine pressure from building against the system.
